functions.description: Parse FortiMail statistics log header fields (date, time, device, subtype, severity, hostname, optional src, and message text)

conf.regex: /^date=(?<date>\S+) time=(?<time>\S+) device_id=(?<device_id>\S+) log_id=(?<log_id>\S+) type=(?<log_type>\S+) subtype=(?<subtype>\S+) pri=(?<severity>\S+) vd="(?<vd>[^"]+)"(?: itime=(?<itime>\d+))?(?: hostname="(?<hostname>[^"]+)")?(?: src=(?<src_ip>\S+))? msg="(?<message>[^"]+)"/

functions.description: Split message into a short description and the trailing key=value statistics payload
Extract individual statistic key=value pairs from the msg payload (e.g. total_msg, scanned, usage_pct, etc.)
Build a normalized timestamp from date and time fields
Cleanup scratch fields no longer needed after KVP extraction
